notes.title: Minor update 1.2.1
notes.notes:
A very small update to improve the Daily Challenge and fix a couple of bugs.

[h3]Daily Challenge changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Session time now displays seconds in the leaderboard
[*] If you give up, your time will not be registered
[*] Bonus country trait is now assigned to the first agent like in Classic mode
[*] Finishing a Daily Challenge after the time limit will not be registered
[/list]

[h3]Various[/h3]
[list]
[*] UI improvements
[*] Mission requesting to give a weapon out will now properly remove the weapon from the agent's inventory when completed
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Daily challenge wasn't the same depending on the owned DLC
[*] Fixed: Bug when an agent resign while traveling
[*] Fixed: Bug where an AI was controlling a clone of the player's country, triggering a lot of issues
[*] Fixed: Custom agent not working
[*] Fixed: Organization missions targeting specific countries
[/list]

notes.title: Nigeria DLC and update 1.10 out now
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32332878/13e5b844b07b7a2793ed65a507d50a9407ca51f1.jpg[/img]

Dear agents, the Nigeria - Additional Nation DLC and the update 1.10. are both available on Steam and GOG.
The game, the DLC and the soundtrack are 33% off for a limited time. Time to get sneaky!

[h2]Update 1.10[/h2]
This update addresses the most worrying balancing issue: STRENGTH vs INTELLIGENCE agents.
To solve this issue, we’ve decided to tweak the exfiltrations to make it more easier for STR-based agents and harder for INT-based agents.
That way, we hope STR-based agents will get picked up more often and will encourage action-packed playstyle into the meta.

[h3]**Full patchnote**[/h3]
[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Exfiltration: tweaked math behind combat during exfiltration
[*] Exfiltration: fleeing always costs health
[*] Exfiltration: Mission with minimum alert level are slightly longer
[*] Searching for a weapon is always a success (but weapon found still varies)
[*] Only agents with smuggler/firearms expert trait start with an assault rifle, others start with a pistol
[*] A flag is displayed on agents hacking a country 
[*] Notifications are no longer deleted after an exfiltration
[*] Organisation leaders are now exfiltrated to the country that ordered their capture
[*] Story mode achievements trigger when actually reaching the story ending
[*] Various UI improvements
[*] In-game recruitment dialogs play fast if fast dialogs option is enabled
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed: wrong portrait was shown when exfiltrating an organisation leader
[*] Fixed: some Russian localization
[*] Fixed: sometimes an agent couldn't be dragged to a country
[*] Fixed: countries displaying more than 100% progress on the sigma project
[*] Fixed: Leak and Anticapitalist Army are now unlocked if a technology is open-sourced
[*] Fixed: agents could get trait they already have or lose trait they don't have
[*] Fixed: lobbies with all technologies discovered could still be angry at the player
[*] Fixed: reloading the game was preventing agents to retreat from a country
[*] Fixed: game could freeze when an agent was resigning while in a trip
[*] Fixed: spy required contact and agent said contact is established in the same turn
[*] Fixed: some events wrongly led to an agent resigning
[*] Fixed: resigned agents were shown in the dashboard as available agents
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steam/apps/1243710/ss_b86002224ddb6b5adc6f6dc3b5e01f23f44769e9.jpg?t=1581430531[/img]

[h2]Nigeria - Additional Nation (DLC)[/h2]
This paid DLC comes up packed with the first new playable country: Nigeria including:
[list]
[*] 4 Nigerian agents (Pure, Witch, Warrior, Dealer)
[*] 2 Nigerian scientists

notes.title: Announcing Nigeria DLC and update 1.10
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32332878/13e5b844b07b7a2793ed65a507d50a9407ca51f1.jpg[/img]

Dear agents, we are pleased to announce the Nigeria - Additional Nation DLC and the update 1.10. Both will be released simultaneously on February 19th on Steam and later on GOG.

[h1]Free update 1.10[/h1]
This update will address the most worrying balancing issue: STRENGTH vs INTELLIGENCE agents.
To solve this issue, we’ve decided to tweak the exfiltrations to make it more easier for STR-based agents and harder for INT-based agents.
That way, we hope STR-based agents will get picked up more often and will encourage action-packed playstyle into the meta.
There are far more improvements and fixes coming up but we keep that for the full patch note next week.

[h1]Nigeria - Additional Nation (DLC)[/h1]
This paid DLC will come up packed with the first new playable country: Nigeria including:
[list]
[*] 4 Nigerian agents (Pure, Witch, Warrior, Dealer)
[*] 2 Nigerian scientists
[*] 1 Nigerian diplomat
[*] Exfiltration in the city of Abuja, Nigeria
[*] Nigeria special bonus: immune to Armed Groups
[/list]

We really wanted to make this as part of the free update. But making new content is rather costly. And we don’t think we’ll be able to keep the project sustainable in the long run if we release everything for free. DLCs will be cheap (this one is $2.99) and non-mandatory to play future updates. Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Sigma Theory 1.0 to release on November 21
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32332878/6e7a20c8b371f2422616c277db32a6feb9af980c.jpg[/img]
Dear agents,

We’ve got very exciting news here at the Bureau:
Sigma Theory will get out of Early Access this Thursday 21 November with the release of Version 1.0! 
We very excited to share with you the best version of the game (yet) including all the new content we’ve added along the way (new agents, Story Mode, Workshop…). It’s been a tough path to get there, and we couldn’t do it without your support and feedback. So on behalf of the team: THANK YOU!

BUT... The development won’t stop there. We’ve got a lot more content in store we’ll deploy in the coming months.

Here’s a glimpse at what’s coming up with 1.0:
[list]
[*] Shiny New UI Improvements! Even more fluid than before.
[*] New keyboard shortcuts! Overrule your opponent with your lightning speed!!
[*] New sound effects. So smooth, so clean.
[*] New buildings for exfiltration. It’s like a whole new world opening before your eyes!
[*] Even more bug fixes because bugs SUCK!!
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.21 - Equilibrium
notes.notes:
Dear agents,
In this last update before the full release in November, we focused our efforts on balancing the gameplay and improving the feedback of your actions.
This will make the game more rewarding when making the right decisions.
We're quite confident those changes will make the overall experience less frustrating and more satisfying. Please let us know your impressions.

[h1]Full patchnote[/h1]
--- 0.21.0 ---

[b]Visuals[/b]
New buildings for South Korea, Germany and China

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32332878/becf9d2ee565b8853c4669b8cb441c7cb8554216.jpg[/img]

[b]Balancing[/b]
[list]
[*] Opponents now research the ultimate technology just like the player
[*] Balanced some contracts that were too difficult to complete
[*] Hacking is now working as intended in relation to the position of the hacker
[*] Traits bonus have been increased
[*] Contract requiring a drone are now completed after the drone has reached its target
[*] Honest and Suggestible traits don't prevent agents to bribe or convince targets anymore but decrease chances of success
[*] Rework of counter-espionage mechanics: the number of spy in your country is now related to the number of scientists in your Sigma lab
[*] Drones now need 2 days to travel to an other country
[*] Scientists exfiltrated from an eliminated country are not affected by the prisoner trait anymore 
[*] Diplomacy: compromising files don't decrease relationship anymore and make the negociation easier
[*] Ranking is now based on the Sigma tokens collected and final tech progress rather than the total progress on each branches
[/list] 

[b]Various[/b]
[list]
[*] Various UI improvements
[*] Modified hacker detection mechanics
[*] Prisonners' will is now reset each day
[*] Clicks during dialogues now display instantly the speech bubbles
[*] Various balancing tweaks
[*] Scientists' identity is no longer hidden when displaced to an other country by an opponent
[*] Ranking is now based on the avancement on the final project (or on sigma points if no one is searching the final project)
[/list]
 
[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug when conflict starts as an agent discovers the first scientist
[*] Fixed bug where wrong diplomat could talk when a war starts
[*] Fixed bug when agent quits at the same time that they are supposed to arrive to a country
[/list]

notes.title: Sigma Theory Early Access update 0.18
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/3cc7e0a13f0555526189575e7ed32328d7c6a656.jpg[/img]

Dear agents, here comes update 0.18 - packed with pretty cool stuff! Spouse mechanic rework, new hacking UI, Steam Workshop integration and a couple new characters.
And, as always, gameplay balancing and bug fixes.

[h1]Steam Workshop[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/9690be45af2712d947a9a2735ce6aaba9c8379b2.jpg[/img]

[b]Agent creation[/b]
You can now create the agents of your dreams! With the simple in-game tools, you can create and share original characters in minutes. Everything is customizable: traits, origin, portrait...

[b]Custom localization[/b]
If you feel like localizing the game in your own language, it is now possible via the in-game tools or a simple CSV file for easy team work. Feel free to share your localization to the Steam community via the workshop!

We’ll improve the UI and add new features progressively.

[h1]Spouse mechanics rework[/h1]
The spouse mechanics was one of the weakest feature at launch and it was one of the most requested change from the community. We’ve worked hard since then to make this feature more relevant and challenging. We can’t wait to have your feedback on this.

[h1]New characters[/h1]
[b]New agent : Domingo[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/48af4cf094cf9f7d9bc6e4955d573efcbbe861ad.png[/img]
As an e-sport champion with numerous international awards, PAB12 is an enigma: no one knows his real identity. He is young, talented, and already famous. His anonymity is partly explained by his secret activities: addicted to the intensity of e-sport, he began to participate in clandestine competitions as well as illegal poker tournaments. As a result, while in mafia circles, he discovered the trafficking of humans, animals, weapons and drugs, activities that he decided to fight personally, less out of a spirit of justice than out of a search for the excitement of putting his life on the line. An excellent knife fighter, it was mainly through hacking and cunning that he succeeded in placing the police on the path of the traffickers, as in a strategy game. With his modern and complete vision of the world, PAB12 is an agent with undeniable potential.

[b]New character : Combat Drone Operator[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/71fad5ff65ec454271854c680edd9ce467bb46a0.jpg[/img]
This guy will say hi next time you’ll order a strike.


[h1]New hacking UI[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/6a56eb65b3039fbcd994495a0350ff96a7c43189.jpg[/img]
We’ve created a completely new hacking user interface. As always, feel free to share your feedback in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/716640/discussions/]the forum[/url] or on the [url=https://discord.gg/sQ2TzcR]Discord server[/url]. 


[h1]Full Patchnote[/h1]
[b]----Version 0.18.0 ----[/b]

Various
[list]
[*] Improved Hacking UI
[*] Workshop feature : agent creation
[*] Workshop feature : custom localization
[*] Revamped spouse mechanics
[*] New agent : Domingo
[*] New character : Combat Drone Operator
[*] Various balancing tweaks
[*] Various feedback improvement 
[*] It is now easier to see if a country has left the Sigma race
[*] Drones now take only 1 turn to fly between countries that are very close to       each other
[/list]

Bug
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where some counter-terrorist missions couldn't be completed
[*] Fixed occasional freeze in exfiltration phases
[*] Fixed various minor visual bugs
[*] Fixed bug where starting a war with a country could bring prisoner agents back to player's country
[*] Fixed bug where recruitment button in recruitment scene was offscreen in large resolutions
[*] Fixed bug where UI was blocked after clicking "Return to title screen" and then "Cancel"
[*] Fixed bug where scientists could be exfiltrated by two agents at once in countries which lost sigma race
[/list]

notes.title: Sigma Theory Early Access Update 0.17
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/c13e09af8ef3708115d55f1573d4555da14c774e.jpg[/img]

Dear agents, please welcome update 0.17! This update brings a new game mode and makes the end game more challenging with the end game balancing. The UI got some polish here and there for your convenience. And, of course, more bugs have been fixed.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/47cab9c2de2ebc753e12e5a3fbaf8ae24a1ae4cd.png[/img]

[h1]Custom Mode[/h1]
When starting a new game, you can now choose between ‘Classic’ or ‘Custom’ mode. Custom mode lets you tweak game mechanics to fit your needs. We’ve created some presets you can start off with : ‘Easy’, ‘Normal’ and ‘Hard’. Leaderboards, achievements and agent unlock are disabled when playing a custom game.
If you have some suggestions about options that could be added, please let us know!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/7f6fb586cb457baf134799dab2765c1c27c31eb6.png[/img]

[h1]End game balancing[/h1]
To make the end game more challenging, the AIs will now be able to develop the Sigma project as well. So you’ll have to be more aggressive and disrupt your opponents research if you want to win the technological race. Good luck with that!

[h1]What’s up next[/h1]
Modding tools (via Steam Workshop) are taking life slowly and we hope to have a first iteration for you in the next update. We are firstly aiming at localization tools and character creation (agents and diplomats).
Spouse mechanics rework and new scoring system are also on the way.

[h1]Full Patchnote[/h1]
---- Version 0.17.0 ----

[b]Various[/b]
[list]
[*] Opponents now research the final Sigma project as well
[*] Added a tooltip indicating research progress on the final Sigma project
[*] Added a Wiki button in title screen
[*] Added visual feedback on the ‘End Turn’ button
[*] Added the option to give up
[*] Added fullscreen toggle option in the settings
[*] Added possibility to cancel when changing settings
[*] Added option to toggle the tutorial
[*] Added ‘Custom’ mode with difficulty presets
[*] Added loading screen
[/list]

[b]Bug[/b]
[list]
[*] Event unlocking Wolf will now only happen once.
[*] Removed empty recruitment punchline for Wolf
[*] Missions asking to plant a ransomware on a country now succeed next turn if a ransomware is already there
[*] Fixed bug where notifications of sigma progress of a country could sometimes be showed twice
[*] Cancelled actions on a scientist if a scientist is obtained by diplomacy in the meantime
[*] Fixed bug where tutorial could show up about a prisoner that player already freed in a diplomatic meeting
[*] Fixed bug where sometimes some dirt on a diplomat couldn't be used
[*] Fixed bug where businessman agent could glitch out if trying to travel at the same time than an other agent
[*] Fixed bug where it was possible to start two wars with the same country at once
[*] Fixed bug achievement Financial Wizardry and Checkpoint Charlie
[/list]

notes.title: Sigma Theory Early Access update 0.16.4
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/6bff28d53dfc23ba3e1391fa09144d6753c6195b.jpg[/img]

Dear agents, here’s update 0.16.4, where we’ve fixed most of the request from the community plus wide range of more subtle bugs. We’re very happy to see the list of showstoppers decreasing dramatically, which means we’ll be able to focus more on new content and features in the next updates.

[b]New content[/b]
Speaking of new content, we have added a new and mysterious agent that will appear in-game if specific events are triggered. One thing we can tell is that this agent will never let you down and it might become your best friend.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/91d2cd1b55a779f6c57177e53fdb9a7bce64979e.jpg[/img]

[b]Quality of life[/b]
We've fixed the last (hopefully) UI related glitches and freezes. The game should be hassle free from now on! Also, language settings won't set back to default anymore.

[b]What's up next?[/b]
We’ve made good progress on the first ‘Story Mode’. So here’s a bit more info about it!
Each Story Mode will have a unique storyline with missions and dialogues involving new and unique characters with multiple endings. Each ending will unlock a specific character from the Story Mode for recruitment. 
Needless to say we can’t wait to share the first ‘Story Mode’ with you! But you'll have to wait a few more weeks before experiencing it!


[h1]Full Patchnote[/h1]
---Version 0.16.4---

[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]It is now impossible to set a meeting with a diplomat everyday
[*]Mission tooltips now display everything that might influence the chances of success
[*]Using a compromising file against a diplomat will prevent you from improving your relation with their country and even decrease the relation
[*]Globally increased the negotiation bonus given by compromising files
[*]Releasing an enemy spy during a meeting is more efficient
[*]Removed Exfiltration Master trait from Agent Espoir
[*]Added a new mysterious elite agent
[/list]

[b]Bug fix[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug when sending a drone to a conflict zone for an organisation mission
[*]Fixed a bug where loading an older save resulted in countries not actually losing the game ever
[*]Fixed a bug where language settings were set back to default after a game is over
[*]Fixed a bug where language settings weren’t saved
[*]Fixed a bug where a dead spouse would still triggered events
[*]Fixed a bug where the exfiltration briefing launched by a random event kept showing up after every exfiltration
[*]Fixed glitches related to the radial menu that were causing UI freezes
[*]Disabled game controllers recognition to avoid them interfering with the camera controls
[/list]

notes.title: Sigma Theory Early Access update 0.16.3
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/a73b07d838fce583aa0b70f63636908f50de0a00.jpg[/img]

Dear agents, here’s update 0.16.3, featuring balancing, bug fixing and community requested changes (and a bit of eye candy too).

[b]Gameplay/Balancing[/b]
In this update, we continued our effort to balance the Diplomacy, and make it less easier to acquire scientists. Our goal is to progrssively move the meta toward the exfiltration as the main solution to get scientists as it was originally intended. This will ramp up the overall difficulty of the game and make Strength based agents more useful. We will listen to your feedback and continue to tweak the diplomacy mechanics in future updates if needed.

[b]Graphics[/b]
Each country now has a unique color flavors during exfiltrations to add variety.
We’ve also added new and shiny Soviet buildings that you’ll discover during your missions in Russia.

[b]Quality of life[/b]
As widely requested, there is now an option to skip the dialogue animations entirely.
For exotic resolutions, you can now resize the game window to fit your screen accordingly.

[h1]Full patchnote[/h1]
---- Version 0.16.3 ----

[b]Various[/b]
[list]
[*]Offering your gratitude during diplomatic meetings now decreases the trust gauge as originally intended
[*]Decreased chances of success when asking for a scientist during diplomatic meetings
[*]Fixed various gameplay issues when a country is eliminated: war with those countries is now instantly ended, missions from organisations are cancelled, arrest warrants are removed ...
[*]Russia now has some typically Russian buildings in exfiltration missions
[*]Different camera filters are now applied in exfiltration mission according to which country it takes place in
[*]Added various UI improvements and feedbacks
[*]Improved exfiltration loading time
[*]Added a visual effect when a branch of the final project is completed, allowing player to see if there are a few missing percents on a slot
[*]Added an option to speed up dialogues
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where the first captured agent could be killed by an event during the same turn, preventing the player from completing the counterespionage tutorial
[*]Fixed bug where it was possible to drag the drone on an inactive (and invisible) conflict zone, resulting in unpredictable behaviors
[*]Fixed bug where drones weren't given back to the player when they should
[*]Authorization by hierarchy to use drones or not is only checked once a turn, preventing various bugs
[*]Fixed bug where menus and tooltips weren't properly hidden in some resolutions, leading to a game blocked in the case of menus
[*]Fixed occasional freeze when using Mentalis technology for yourself
[*]Fixed bug where the game tries to open a conflict zone when all active countries already have an active conflict zone, creating a wide range of problems down the road, like agents not being able to finish their action
[/list]

notes.title: Sigma Theory update 0.16.2.2
notes.notes:
Dear agents, here are the main changes for patch 0.16.2.2.

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where Braincase and Force 1 traits didn't do anything
[*] Fixed bug where leader of a terrorist organisation was still shown as a target after being captured
[*] Fixed bug where hackers could report that they got all information on scientists when they only got locations
[*] Skip intro scene

notes.title: Sigma Theory Beta Update 0.12 patch note
notes.notes:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/716640/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/f3761ee0c62b7d02e402c137d7064c643c09074b.jpg[/img][/url]
[h1]New features[/h1]
[b]Counterespionage[/b]
The first iteration of counterespionage was too passive and required to anchor one (or more) of your agents in your country. We’ve added new mechanics so you can be more proactive to prevent spy activities on your soil while using all your agents abroad.
Your counterespionage service will send a notification everytime a suspicious agent lands in your country. From there, you’ll have a limited time to send an agent back home to counter the enemy before they leave your country with a scientist.
There’s even the possibility to capture a spy for interrogation, see below.

[b]Interrogation[/b]
When a spy is captured, they will be at your disposal for interrogation. This is a new feature that works a little bit like the diplomatic meeting. It’s quite different though, as the prisoner has a Will level and Health level. Your goal is lowering their Will level while keeping their Health level high to prevent death. Use interrogation and torture options to get intel.
Once you have everything you need, you can trade the prisoner during Diplomatic Meetings.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/716640/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/51c673d3d870e6175e0cc244e733d76ca94aa68d.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]New contents[/h1]
[b]New agents[/b]
[list]
[*]Diplomat (China)
[*]Zenith (Turkey)
[*]Rider (Japan)
[*]Enigma (United Kingdom)
[*]Catch (South Korea)
[*]Scar (Turkey)
[/list]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/716640/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/3a625bbaf2cd1be00da480270445a4d22d3e28fc.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]Organization quest system[/b]
Each organization in the game has now its own quest line you’ll have to complete to improve your standing with them and receive advantages.
This brings more backstory to the different factions while giving you clear objectives and useful rewards. But remember that dealing with certain organizations will have its fair share of diplomatic backfire.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/716640/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/9234e15589973e6d059180a4765eaa27b9cc302d.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Dashboard improvements
[*]Balancing of ‘Loyal’, ‘Chaste’ and ‘Incorruptible’ scientist traits
[*]Scientists now lose ‘Prisoner’ trait if brought back in their initial country
[*]Infiltration between France, UK and Germany now takes only one day

[*]New travel UI
[/list]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/716640/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/ab4103616844c4619b534be5db853d5474c5a7f9.jpg[/img][/url]

[*]During exfiltration, events where agent can get treatment now only show up when agent is hurt
[*]Fixed bug where a critical failure in hack could lead to a wrong notification text
[*]More bug fixes...
[/list]

notes.title: Sigma Theory: Global Cold War To Release On April 18th
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7403583/193fd8c3969c88a44cebcd9be287db2070575ce4.png[/img]

From the creators of the award-winning sci-fi game Out There comes Sigma Theory: Global Cold War, Mi-Clos Studio’s new futuristic turn-based cold war spy simulation game. After a paradigm-shifting scientific discovery, the titular Sigma Theory, the player is invited to build their own intelligence agency and delve deep into a shadowy world of subterfuge and back-stabbing diplomacy. Heavily influenced by the creators’ real-life experience in the intelligence industry, players will recruit, bribe, and assassinate to ensure their chosen nation will lead the planet towards a radical new future. Sigma Theory is set to release on April 18th, 2019 for PC, Mac and Linux.
